name: Cyber Lime
tagline: AutoMontage's cyber theme: near-black, lime glow, Oswald captions on dark glass, masks and jump cuts.

motion.direction: AutoMontage `cyber`. Dark cards (`mar`, radius 18) with a lime `ter` 2 px border and a lime glow, Oswald uppercase, mono labels. Elements enter under an 8-frame mask (0.32 s, ease 0.16/1/0.3/1) or a spring pop, exit in 5 frames; word stagger 2–3 frames. Captions: karaoke groups < 4 words, lime on the spoken word. Jump cuts 1.0 / 1.18 / 1.12, a punch to 1.15 on the single peak. ≤ 2 moving text blocks at once, no bounce on text, same motion never 3× in a row, nothing on the face in the first 2 s.
